title: US President Donald Trump names Stephen Miller as White House chief of staff
summary: Trump said he would be replacing Susie Wiles as chief of staff. Miller is controversial figure, known as a key architect of the administration’s hard-line immigration policies.

image.caption: Stepehn Miller replaces outgoing Trump loyalist Susie WilesImage: Aaron Schwartz/ABACAPRESS/IMAGO

blocks.text: US President Donald ‌Trump announced on ⁠Friday ⁠that his ​deputy chief of ​staff and architect of his administration's strict immigration policy, Stephen Miller, will become his new chief of staff.
Miller replaces Susie Wiles, who had been in the post since Trump's inauguration. With the nod, Miller becomes the top aide to the president.
Trump announced the move saying Miller was "one of my most trusted advisors" a
Susie Wiles, who has done an outstanding job, will be moving over to the Trump Political Operation. I want to thank her for her service as Chief of Staff — She has done a great job!
Trump thanked Wiles, saying she had done an "outstanding job" and adding that she would continue to work for his political organization.

Wiles also commented on her exit from the White House, saying that her work there was "the honor of a lifetime." She said she was proud of what the administration had accomplished during her tenure, including "securing our border and cutting taxes to strengthening our economy and putting America First."
This is a developing story, more details to come...
